solution:
const inf = Infinity
const negInf = -Infinity
return {
  infGreaterThanMillion: inf > 1000000,
  negInfLessThan: negInf < -999999,
  isFinite: isFinite(inf)
}
hints: Infinity koi bhi number se bada hota hai
isFinite() check karta hai finite hai ya nahi
